# Copilot workspace instructions

Read `/AGENTS.md` and `/TASK.md` before making changes. This project is a clean-room rebuild of the user-provided reference files in `/reference/original` using the approved assets in `/public/assets`.

Implement the task end-to-end instead of stopping at a plan. Keep the project Vite + Vanilla JavaScript unless a blocker proves otherwise. All personalizable copy, phone number, audio URL, limits, and asset paths belong in `/src/config.js`. Run build/tests and fix errors before finishing.
